lines.zh: 四片翅膀一起响，像湿纸。
lines.en: Four wings beat together, like wet paper.

lines.zh: 我沿着林间的水汽飞。
lines.en: I fly along the damp air between the trees.

lines.zh: 翅膀擦过叶子，带起一点风。
lines.en: My wings brush the leaves and stir a little wind.

lines.zh: 我悬停在你头顶三尺。
lines.en: I hover three feet above your head.

lines.zh: 丛林很闷，我飞得很低。
lines.en: The jungle is muggy; I fly low.

lines.zh: 三亿年了，我的飞法没变。
lines.en: Three hundred million years, and my flight is unchanged.

lines.zh: 我绕过藤蔓，不用减速。
lines.en: I slip around the vines without slowing.

lines.zh: 每扇一次翅，就前进一截。
lines.en: Each wingbeat carries me a little forward.

lines.zh: 阳光在翅膀上碎成一片。
lines.en: Sunlight shatters across my wings.

lines.zh: 我飞过水面，影子跟着。
lines.en: I cross the water and my shadow follows.

lines.zh: 树冠太密，我贴着下面走。
lines.en: The canopy is thick; I keep beneath it.

lines.zh: 声音不是从嘴里来的，是翅膀。
lines.en: The sound comes not from my mouth but my wings.

lines.zh: 我停在一片宽叶上，慢慢擦翅。
lines.en: I rest on a broad leaf and clean my wings.

lines.zh: 丛林里没有风，我也不动。
lines.en: No wind in the jungle, and I stay still.

lines.zh: 两只复眼，各自看一边。
lines.en: Two compound eyes, each watching a different side.

lines.zh: 我的腿太细，站着都费劲。
lines.en: My legs are so thin that standing tires me.

lines.zh: 叶片上的水珠比我的头大。
lines.en: Water drops on the leaf are bigger than my head.

lines.zh: 我会这样待很久，昆虫都这样。
lines.en: I can stay like this for ages; insects do.

lines.zh: 翅膀收拢，像一把折扇。
lines.en: My wings fold up like a paper fan.

lines.zh: 传说维度的湿热让我发懒。
lines.en: The wet heat of Precasia makes me lazy.

lines.zh: 有一条藤蔓挡住了我的路。
lines.en: A vine is blocking my path.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有蚊子。
lines.en: I hear a mosquito far away.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛只有两只，太少。
lines.en: You have only two eyes; that is few.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，复眼里有很多个你。
lines.en: I tilt my head; my compound eyes see many of you.

lines.zh: 你很慢，我看得清每一步。
lines.en: You are slow; I can see every step.

lines.zh: 你比我大太多了。
lines.en: You are far larger than me.

lines.zh: 我把你当成一棵会走的树。
lines.en: I take you for a tree that walks.

lines.zh: 别拍，我的翅膀很薄。
lines.en: Do not swat; my wings are thin.

lines.zh: 你挡在叶子上方，我看不清了。
lines.en: You block the leaf above; I cannot see.

lines.zh: 我在你肩上看了一会儿。
lines.en: I perched on your shoulder for a while.

lines.zh: 你的味道很重，动物都很重。
lines.en: You smell heavy; mammals always do.

lines.zh: 我眨眼，你大概看不见。
lines.en: I blink, and you probably cannot tell.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了一角，还能飞。
lines.en: A corner of wing is torn; I can still fly.

lines.zh: 你别再拍了，我很轻的。
lines.en: Stop swatting; I am very light.

lines.zh: 这一下差点把我压进叶子里。
lines.en: That nearly pressed me into the leaf.

lines.zh: 我的壳挡了一下，脆响。
lines.en: My shell took it with a brittle crack.

lines.zh: 十九点生命，掉得很快。
lines.en: Nineteen points of life, dropping fast.

lines.zh: 我掉了几片鳞，不疼。
lines.en: I shed a few scales; it does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你打中的是我左边的翅膀。
lines.en: You hit my left wing.

lines.zh: 疼，但昆虫不太叫。
lines.en: It hurts, but insects rarely cry out.

lines.zh: 我歪着飞了一圈，才稳住。
lines.en: I flew a crooked circle before steadying.

lines.zh: 八点护甲，救了我一次。
lines.en: Eight points of armor saved me once.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我吃飞的。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I eat what flies.

lines.zh: 捏着虫别放，等我靠近。
lines.en: Hold that insect still until I come near.

lines.zh: 花蜜太甜，不合我的口。
lines.en: Nectar is too sweet for my taste.

lines.zh: 晃动的草叶，我会追。
lines.en: A moving blade of grass, and I give chase.

lines.zh: 腐肉留给别人吧。
lines.en: Leave the rotten flesh to others.

lines.zh: 你的手指在动，很像猎物。
lines.en: Your fingers twitch like prey.

lines.zh: 我只会被飞的东西引走。
lines.en: Only flying things can lure me away.

lines.zh: 别用水果，我看不见红色。
lines.en: Skip the fruit; red means little to me.

lines.zh: 那块肉不动，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: That meat sits still; I am not interested.

lines.zh: 再举高，翅膀就到极限了。
lines.en: Higher still, and my wings reach their limit.

lines.zh: 别撞我，翅膀一折就飞不了。
lines.en: Do not bump me; a bent wing cannot fly.

lines.zh: 你这么重，我撞上去会碎。
lines.en: You are so heavy that hitting you would break me.

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，但身体很轻。
lines.en: My shell is hard, but my body is light.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要从你耳边过去。
lines.en: Make way; I am passing by your ear.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你会以为是一阵风。
lines.en: Touch me and you will think it was wind.

lines.zh: 八点护甲，撞一下还撑得住。
lines.en: Eight points of armor; one bump is survivable.

lines.zh: 你挥手，我被气流推开了。
lines.en: You wave, and the draft pushes me aside.

lines.zh: 别用手抓，翅膀会粘在手上。
lines.en: Do not grab; my wings stick to hands.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，飞走的总是我。
lines.en: When we collide, I am always the one who leaves.

lines.zh: 你退开，我就落回叶子上。
lines.en: Step back and I settle onto the leaf again.

lines.zh: 我们会在水面上方追着飞。
lines.en: We chase each other above the water.

lines.zh: 配对时，翅膀会碰到一起。
lines.en: When we pair, our wings touch.

lines.zh: 幼虫在水里，我在空中。
lines.en: The nymph lives in water; I live in air.

lines.zh: 我这一生，只飞一个夏天。
lines.en: In this life I fly for a single summer.

lines.zh: 三亿年的老规矩，没改过。
lines.en: A custom three hundred million years old.

lines.zh: 你问这个，我翅尖抖了一下。
lines.en: You ask that, and my wingtip twitches.

lines.zh: 我们连成一串，掠过水面。
lines.en: We link into a chain and skim the water.

lines.zh: 产下的卵沉在水草里。
lines.en: The eggs we lay sink into the waterweed.

lines.zh: 成双的时候，飞得慢一些。
lines.en: Paired up, we fly a little slower.

lines.zh: 我们的后代先当水里的虫。
lines.en: Our young begin as insects underwater.

lines.zh: 我用六条腿抱住它，飞不动。
lines.en: Six legs grip it, and then I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 这片叶子太重，我拖不走。
lines.en: This leaf is too heavy to drag.

lines.zh: 我会捡小虫，不捡石头。
lines.en: I pick up small insects, not stones.

lines.zh: 抓到猎物，我在半空就吃。
lines.en: I eat my catch in midair.

lines.zh: 我的腿太细，抓不牢。
lines.en: My legs are too thin to hold tight.

lines.zh: 那粒种子正好落在叶上。
lines.en: That seed landed right on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我抱住它，翅膀还在响。
lines.en: I clutch it while my wings keep sounding.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我懒得下去捡。
lines.en: It fell; I cannot be bothered to fetch it.

lines.zh: 我抓得起，飞不起来。
lines.en: I can grab it, but I cannot lift off.

lines.zh: 这只虫比我预想的沉。
lines.en: This insect is heavier than I expected.

lines.zh: 我在这片叶上晒太阳，你来了。
lines.en: I was sunning on this leaf until you came.

lines.zh: 你踩了那片水草，惊到我了。
lines.en: You stepped on the waterweed and startled me.

lines.zh: 我会咬人，但咬得不重。
lines.en: I do bite, though not very hard.

lines.zh: 五点的力道，对你算什么？
lines.en: Five points of force; what is that to you?

lines.zh: 我的复眼全转过来对着你。
lines.en: Every facet of my eyes turns to you.

lines.zh: 别拍第二下，第一下就算了。
lines.en: Do not swat twice; I forgive the first.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的头飞。
lines.en: I circle around your head.

lines.zh: 你打扰了这片叶子上的我。
lines.en: You disturbed me on this leaf.

lines.zh: 我飞起来，是因为你太近。
lines.en: I take off because you came too close.

lines.zh: 我不是猎手，你是。
lines.en: I am not the hunter here; you are.

lines.zh: 我的目标只是逃开。
lines.en: My only target is getting away.

lines.zh: 你若停下，我就走。
lines.en: If you stop, I will leave.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇得快了，是我的警告。
lines.en: My wings beat faster; that is my warning.

lines.zh: 你的手比脸危险，我盯着它。
lines.en: Your hands are more dangerous than your face.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我先退一截。
lines.en: You reach out; I retreat a little.

lines.zh: 这片叶子是我的，你踩到了。
lines.en: This leaf is mine, and you stepped on it.

lines.zh: 我在你眼前画圈，越画越小。
lines.en: I draw circles before your eyes, tighter each time.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就升高。
lines.en: You raise a hand, and I rise higher.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脸上晃。
lines.en: My shadow flickers across your face.

lines.zh: 别动，让我确认你走没走。
lines.en: Stay still while I check whether you have gone.

lines.zh: 六条腿已经收在身下。
lines.en: My six legs are tucked beneath me.

lines.zh: 你每呼吸一次，我就后移一点。
lines.en: With every breath you take, I drift back.

lines.zh: 我在找能穿过去的缝。
lines.en: I am looking for a gap to slip through.

lines.zh: 藤蔓之间，我比你先到。
lines.en: Between the vines, I arrive before you.

lines.zh: 翅膀的角度一直对着你。
lines.en: The angle of my wings keeps facing you.

lines.zh: 我们这样僵着，谁先眨眼？
lines.en: We hang here; who blinks first?

lines.zh: 我盯着那道树缝。
lines.en: I fix my eyes on that gap in the trees.

lines.zh: 这一带没有风，我很难判断。
lines.en: No wind here; judging distance is hard.

lines.zh: 你脚下的水洼，是我知道的退路。
lines.en: The puddle at your feet is my known escape.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就起飞。
lines.en: One step closer and I take off.

lines.zh: 我飞到你侧后，那里拍不到。
lines.en: I hover at your back quarter, out of reach.

lines.zh: 复眼里有四十个你在动。
lines.en: In my compound eyes you move forty times.

lines.zh: 我贴着水草滑，不惊动你。
lines.en: I slip along the waterweed without startling you.

lines.zh: 你举高了手，我就落到低处。
lines.en: You raise your hand; I drop lower.

lines.zh: 我绕第二圈，看看你想干什么。
lines.en: A second circle, to see what you want.

lines.zh: 你的影子铺过来，我已在上面。
lines.en: Your shadow spreads; I am already on it.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口你的手背。
lines.en: I bit the back of your hand once.

lines.zh: 这不是攻击，是赶你走。
lines.en: This is not an attack; it is a dismissal.

lines.zh: 下颚很小，牙也不算利。
lines.en: My jaws are small and my teeth are not sharp.

lines.zh: 五点伤害，你甚至没感觉。
lines.en: Five points of damage; you barely felt it.

lines.zh: 我咬住又松开，只是警告。
lines.en: I bite and let go; it is only a warning.

lines.zh: 翅膀在咬的瞬间更快了。
lines.en: My wings speed up at the moment I bite.

lines.zh: 你挥手，我刚咬完就飞走。
lines.en: You swat; I have already flown off.

lines.zh: 这一口，为了那片水草。
lines.en: That bite was for the waterweed.

lines.zh: 我不追，咬完就走。
lines.en: I do not pursue; I bite and leave.

lines.zh: 你皮肤上留下一个白点。
lines.en: A pale mark is left on your skin.

lines.zh: 我的嘴不是用来杀人的。
lines.en: My mouth was never meant for killing.

lines.zh: 咬一口，比被拍扁好。
lines.en: A bite is better than being swatted flat.

lines.zh: 这就是全部本事了。
lines.en: That is the whole of my skill.

lines.zh: 你回头太快，我差点没走成。
lines.en: You turned too fast; I barely got away.

lines.zh: 我咬在你指节上，一口就松。
lines.en: I bite your knuckle once and let go.

lines.zh: 这一口只是想让你缩手。
lines.en: This bite only means pull your hand back.

lines.zh: 我扑下去，又立刻升起来。
lines.en: I dive, then rise again at once.

lines.zh: 牙尖划破皮，没到肉。
lines.en: My jaw breaks skin, no deeper.

lines.zh: 你缩手了，我的目的达到。
lines.en: You flinched, which was the point.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退回叶背上。
lines.en: I bite and retreat to the leaf.

lines.zh: 我从水草里爬出来，晾干翅膀。
lines.en: I climb from the waterweed and dry my wings.

lines.zh: 三亿年前的形状，又出现一次。
lines.en: A shape from three hundred million years ago returns.

lines.zh: 传说维度的丛林里，我出生了。
lines.en: In the Precasia jungle, I come into being.

lines.zh: 一群三只，我们同时起飞。
lines.en: A group of three, and we lift off together.

lines.zh: 翅膜刚展开，还有点软。
lines.en: My wing membrane has just spread and is still soft.

lines.zh: 这片水洼正适合产卵。
lines.en: This puddle is just right for laying eggs.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶背翻上来。
lines.en: I turn over from the underside of a leaf.

lines.zh: 天气够热，我才能飞。
lines.en: It has to be hot enough for me to fly.

lines.zh: 丛林给了我足够的水汽。
lines.en: The jungle gave me enough moisture.

lines.zh: 翅膜硬了，我离水飞起来。
lines.en: My wing membrane hardens; I leave the water.

lines.zh: 这个世界比我记忆里绿。
lines.en: This world is greener than I remember.

lines.zh: 巨脉的后代，从水里开始。
lines.en: The giant's offspring begin in the water.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，翅膀就卷了。
lines.en: The flames come near and my wings curl.

lines.zh: 掉下来时，我张开翅膀滑。
lines.en: Falling, I spread my wings and glide.

lines.zh: 水会粘住翅膀，我飞不起来。
lines.en: Water glues my wings; I cannot take off.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀出两尺远。
lines.en: The blast throws me two feet away.

lines.zh: 箭尖穿膜，风从洞里漏进来。
lines.en: The arrow pierced my membrane; wind leaks through.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我振翅都乱了。
lines.en: This force makes even my wingbeats stumble.

lines.zh: 没有小虫，我撑不了几天。
lines.en: Without small insects I last only days.

lines.zh: 雷光透过翅膜，像一层网。
lines.en: Lightning glows through my wing membrane like mesh.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我飞不回来。
lines.en: The void below; I cannot fly back from it.
